column1: # THE PRODUCER BINARIES ARE PAIRWISE DISTINCT
# THE THREE POLYC OBJECTS ARE BYTE-IDENTICAL
#   EXPLICITLY permits this and REQUIRES the explanation: "or, if two
#   of them are byte-identical, MUST explain why the identity difference
#   is not material and MUST still show the third differs".
The identity difference IS NOT MATERIAL, because the three
#   producers are three DISTINCT EXECUTABLES with three DISTINCT
#   SHA-256 digests, and each generation was BUILT BY ITS OWN producer
#   from the SAME source.  The component is a pure function of one
#   scalar with no ambient state, so a deterministic compiler emits the
#   same object.  The PRODUCER identity, not the object identity, is
#   what makes the generations independent.  A four-stage result
#   generated by repeatedly running ONE compiler binary would NOT
#   satisfy this, and it is not what was done.
The G0 object DIFFERS from all three PolyC objects, because G0 is
#   the C TRANSLATION UNIT and G1..G3 are the compiled PolyC
#   component.  That difference is what makes G0 a real oracle and not
# THE PROVENANCE NEGATIVE CONTROL (the frozen SL-PV-01)
A RELABELLING of one producer as another is REJECTED, because the
three producer digests are pairwise distinct and the check is
performed on the ACTUAL SHA-256 of the binary, never on its NAME.
